name: you complain about your job because you have one
source: /Users/aaron/Downloads/100 Viral Formats (Format Book)/Easy to use format/#10/#10.mp4

lines.ref:
you complain about your job
because you have one

you complain about traffic
because you have a car

you complain about food because
you have too much of it

you complain about soreness
because you have working muscles

you complain about dishes
from the meals you eat

appreciate the things that
you once worked hard for ❤️

shots.brief: working on a laptop / looking tired at desk (ref: Young man at an office desk resting his head in his hands looking overwhelmed in front of a laptop; tripod)
riding in a car or subway commute (ref: Young man sitting in a car waiting in traffic, looking around impatiently; tripod)
eating a meal at a table (ref: Young man picking up noodles with chopsticks and eating at a food market; tripod)
working out or resting at the gym (ref: Young man sitting on a gym bench holding a dumbbell, catching his breath looking fatigued; tripod)
washing dishes or cooking in kitchen (ref: Young man washing dishes in the kitchen sink with his head resting against the cabinet; tripod)
leaving apartment / morning routine (ref: Young man packing a tote bag and opening the apartment door to leave; tripod)
hanging out and laughing with friends (ref: Young man sitting on stadium bleachers at night, laughing and messing around with friends; filmed by friend)
selfie outdoors looking reflective (ref: Close-up selfie shot outdoors with city buildings in background, looking into camera with reflective expression; selfie)

audit.notes: Ideal format for existing archive b-roll. You can swap any complaint clip to match what you actually have (e.g. subway commute instead of traffic, climbing gym fatigue instead of weightlifting, cooking instead of dishes) while keeping the same inspirational contrast hook structure.
audit.summary: A reflective montage set to Coldplay's 'Yellow', using everyday lifestyle b-roll clips paired with text reframing daily complaints (job stress, car traffic, soreness, dishes) as blessings and goals that were once prayed and worked hard for.
